rationale: With the Chief Justice in dissent, Justice Thomas assigns and is best positioned to write a reversal emphasizing Atkins’s delegation and limiting Hall/Moore to policing rigid, dispositive gatekeeping rather than supervising evidentiary weighting of multiple IQ scores. A Roberts-led dissent is plausible, with some chance of an Alito or Gorsuch concurrence to sharpen the “no federal evidentiary code” boundary while acknowledging the functional Hall backstop.
